feat(agent-scan): support custom transforms for SSE responses (#600)

feat(agent-scan): support custom transforms for SSE responses (#600)

## Summary
- Pass `transform_response` into the SSE parser and apply it to each JSON `data:` event, so HTTP providers with a non-standard response transform can extract streaming content (previously events were normalized before the transform ran, making the transform unable to match).
- Accumulate transformed content separately from the existing fallback parsers; use the transformed content exclusively once at least one event matches, preventing status/metadata events from contaminating output (mixed event shapes).
- Preserve all existing provider-specific parsers (OpenAI / Anthropic / Coze / Dify / plain-text) and token-usage extraction when no event matches the transform.

## Local verification (merge-simulated onto current `main` @ 874d05b4)
- `go build ./...` — exit 0 (no break).
- `go vet ./...` — exit 0 (no new warnings).

- Merge onto current `main` applies cleanly with no conflict.

No associated issue to close. Boy-hack review (2026-08-26) found the fix clean with non-blocking edge-case notes; no modification request was raised and CI is green.
